content.text:
Here are the top 5 parks by arriving guests for the weekend of 19–21 September 2026, alongside the live 2027-season bookings those same parks hold as of today.

| Rank | Park | Arriving Guests (19–21 Sep 2026) | Live 2027 Bookings (as at 25 Sep 2026) |
|------|------|-----------------:|-----------------:|
| 1 | Devon Cliffs | 2,297 | 8,128 |
| 2 | Hafan y Mor | 2,217 | 7,383 |
| 3 | Craig Tara | 2,199 | 5,802 |
| 4 | Primrose Valley | 2,101 | 7,175 |
| 5 | Haggerston | 1,746 | 4,610 |

A couple of things worth flagging: the arrivals ranking is close (Devon Cliffs, Hafan y Mor and Craig Tara are all within ~100 guests), and the 2027 bookings order differs from the arrivals order — Primrose Valley holds more live 2027 bookings than Craig Tara despite ranking lower on that weekend's arrivals.

**Basis:** Arrivals ranking from the arrivals specialist — distinct guests with an arrival date of 19, 20 or 21 Sep 2026, counting all bookings regardless of confirmation status (confirmation data for that weekend is lagging, so a confirmed-only count would badly under-count). Live 2027 bookings from the bookings specialist — bookings with SEASON = 2027 in a "FIRM" status (Booked/Closed/Terminated, i.e. active, non-cancelled), snapshot date 2026-09-25.
